sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Mercury is a fintech company offering software-powered business banking and financial tools for entrepreneurs.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Mercury provides business checking and savings accounts, cards, expense management, payments, invoicing, bill pay, accounting automations, Treasury, loans, and related financial services in one platform. Banking services are provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

sections.label: Mission
sections.content: To make banking better for ambitious entrepreneurs by simplifying outdated and complex financial operations and making banking a catalyst for business growth.

sections.label: Voice & tone
sections.content: Bold, direct, entrepreneurial, technology-focused, and growth-oriented.

sections.label: Problem solved
sections.content: Mercury reduces the complexity, friction, fees, and fragmented tooling associated with business banking and financial operations.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Business checking and savings accounts
Corporate debit and credit cards
Expense management with limits, approvals, reimbursements, and receipt matching
USD domestic and international payments
Invoicing and payment collection
AI-powered bill pay
Accounting integrations and automations for QuickBooks, Xero, and NetSuite
Treasury and cash management

sections.label: Products / SKUs
sections.content:
Mercury Business banking
Mercury Plus
Mercury Pro
Mercury Personal
Mercury Treasury
IO corporate credit card
Mercury Books
Mercury Payroll

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Business banking essentials are available for $0/month with no minimum balance requirements, overdraft fees, or account opening fees. The pricing page lists Mercury Plus at $29.90/month and Mercury Pro at $299/month; paid plans provide advanced workflows and support. Mercury Books is listed at $35/month and Mercury Payroll at $100/month plus $50 per paid person per month, with promotional waivers stated on the pricing page. Mercury Personal is listed at $240/year for standalone accounts and is included with a business plan while the business account remains active and in good standing.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Financial technology for businesses, particularly startups and entrepreneurial companies.

sections.label: Customer base
sections.content: 450,000+ entrepreneurs; customers include startups and businesses in SaaS, ecommerce, and agencies. The site states that 1 in 3 startups choose Mercury, based on its disclosed calculation.

sections.label: Ideal customer profile
sections.content: Ambitious entrepreneurs, startups, and growing businesses that need integrated banking, payments, cards, expense management, invoicing, bill pay, accounting, and cash-management tools. Mercury also serves businesses with complex operations that need advanced workflows and relationship management.

sections.label: Use cases
sections.content:
Opening business checking and savings accounts online
Managing business cash flow and financial operations
Creating and controlling employee and virtual cards
Managing team spending, reimbursements, approvals, and receipts
Sending domestic and international payments
Paying bills and vendors
Creating recurring and one-time invoices and collecting payments
Syncing transactions with accounting platforms

sections.label: Customer outcomes
sections.content:
Faster completion of banking tasks through software and universal search
Reduced fees on eligible USD payments and business banking services
More centralized visibility into funds, transactions, and cash flow
Less manual work through AI-powered bill pay, receipt matching, and accounting automations
Greater control over team spending through card limits, permissions, and approval flows
Faster invoice creation, payment collection, and reconciliation
Access to business banking without in-person visits or paperwork
Up to $5M FDIC insurance for eligible deposits through partner banks and sweep networks
